# Inspect Ranges

> Inspect AI extension for ranges.


## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/index.html.md): Inspect AI extension for ranges.

## Defining Ranges

- [Overview](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/ranges.html.md): What a range definition is: the anatomy of range.yaml, the typed Python surface, end-to-end examples, and the validation workflow.
- [Guests](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/guests.html.md): The guest side of a range definition: hosts, images, resources, accounts, services, seeded weaknesses, defense, and Active Directory.
- [Networks](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/networks.html.md): The range.yaml networking syntax, from a single flat network to multi-router enterprise topologies.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/reference/index.html.md): Command line reference for the inspect-ranges CLI.
- [inspect_ranges](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_ranges/reference/inspect_ranges.html.md): Loading, validation, and revalidation of range definitions.
